# TPC-Havoc Q4_v5

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH qualified_lineitems AS (SELECT DISTINCT l_orderkey FROM lineitem WHERE l_commitdate < l_receiptdate), qualified_orders AS (SELECT o_orderkey, o_orderpriority FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate >= CAST('1993-07-01' AS DATE) AND o_orderdate < CAST('1993-07-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '3 MONTH') SELECT qo.o_orderpriority, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM qualified_orders AS qo INNER JOIN qualified_lineitems AS ql ON qo.o_orderkey = ql.l_orderkey GROUP BY qo.o_orderpriority ORDER BY qo.o_orderpriority
```
